name: Đầu ghi hình IP NVR X86 open platform for software developers and integrators, PoE port Hikvision DS-7600NI-H2/4P(8P)
summary: HDMI output resolution at up to 4MP , VGA output resolution at up to 2MP

description_html:
Intel Celeron Processor(2M Cache, 2.00GHz)

300 Mbps Bit Rate input Max

HDMI output resolution at up to 4MP , VGA output resolution at up to 2MP

2 hot-swappable SATA

4GB memory

2 USB 2.0 & 1 USB 3.0

Alarm in/out : 16/4

1 RJ-45 10/100/1000 Mbps self-adaptive interface

4P/8P models support 4/8 independent 100M PoE network interfaces
